headline: TotalEnergies Completes $800M Sale of Nigerian Onshore Joint Venture Stake
summary: TotalEnergies SE completed the divestment of its 10% non-operated participating interest in the Renaissance joint venture oil licenses in Nigeria for $800 million.
why: TotalEnergies is a French multinational integrated energy major that has been rebalancing its global exploration and production footprint away from onshore West African basins.

impacts.name: TotalEnergies SE
impacts.why: The $800 million cash proceeds strengthen corporate liquidity and reduce operational risks tied to onshore assets.
